PARADOX NOVISSIME - GLYPH CITIES (FREE SAMPLER) v1.0

This is the FREE SAMPLER: 18 models and 12 effects from the full pack (124 models, 16 live effects).

Stylized low-poly alien ruins from the planet Novissime. 100% made with AI, tested in real engines.

  Godot/        drop the ParadoxNovissime folder into your project (Godot 4.4+). Start with Godot/ParadoxNovissime/README.md
  Unity/        drop the ParadoxNovissime folder into Assets/ (Unity 2022+ / 6). One shared material, crisp palette, glow.
  Models_GLB/   every model as .glb (Blender, web, other engines)
  Models_FBX/   every model as .fbx at real-world scale

Contents: 18 models, 12 live effects (Godot).
Docs: Godot/ParadoxNovissime/docs (MODELS, EFFECTS, COMPATIBILITY).
LICENSE.txt: usage terms. CHANGELOG.md: what changed.
